records.title: Amtrak's station portfolio advances while its reported denominator changes across periods
records.finding: Amtrak reports 192 stations with at least partial responsibility addressed in October 2024, 198 in April 2025, 199 in October 2025, and 205 in April 2026, while the associated responsibility denominator moves among 381 or 385, 378, 381 or 382, and 385.
